scenario: T9.8 Manual UX & Accessibility Audit (cirBTC Catalog & Rebaselined Aggregator)

sessions_tested.command: playwright-cli -s=desktop open https://chakra-arc-dex.vercel.app && playwright-cli -s=desktop resize 1280 800 && playwright-cli -s=desktop fill e43 '1'
sessions_tested.details: Header nav, swap terminal, status banner, and tokenIn trigger render cleanly. Direct API request verified: [GET] https://chakra-api-0a5i.onrender.com/api/v1/tokens => [200]. Live interaction trace demonstrates: on initial load tokenIn=USDC, tokenOut=null (Buy panel renders '0.0' with unmounted token selector). When sell input textbox (ref e43) is filled with '1' and debounce wait elapses, no /quote request is fired because quoteKey remains null with tokenOut=null. In the token modal, the /tokens API catalog (USDC, EURC, cirBTC) is displayed. Selecting EURC updates tokenIn=EURC while tokenOut remains null. Clicking 'Swap token direction' swaps EURC to tokenOut (mounting 'EURC' in Buy panel) while leaving tokenIn=null. Root cause: the deployed Vercel bundle (commit d3f8c79 from 2026-08-28) performs case-sensitive address matching (catalogTokens.find(t => t.address === tokenOutAddress)), which fails against the API's lowercase addresses. The local repository on feature-chakra (HEAD 208d5ff / bbda8e0) has the case-insensitive fix (.toLowerCase()) and cirBTC catalog fallback, and passes all 67/67 vitest tests.
